title: Structure and mechanical properties of a new Al0.5CrNbTi2V0.5 high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by arc melting of high-purity (≥99.9 at%) elements in an argon atmosphere inside a water-cooled copper cavity. The produced ingot with dimensions of 6×12×40 mm³ was re-melted 5 times. The cast alloy was annealed at 1200 °C for 24 h in vacuum and cooled down on air.
